To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the best classification algorithms are able to predict approval/failure of a student with an average accuracy of 0.75 and the best regression algorithms are able to estimate the final grade with an average RMSE of 1.3 points.

1) the classification algorithms are better at predicting approval/failure, and the regression algorithms at predicting grades; 2) SVM is the best classification algorithm, but Random Forest, AdaBoost.R2, and SVM are the best regression algorithms.

(i) decision tree algorithms and SVM are the best classification algorithms, while SVM, random forests, and AdaBoost are the best regression algorithms; and (ii) in classification we are able to predict approval/failure with good results, while in regression, we are unable to predict the grade.
